The goal of this notebook:
- see if there are some groups of samples with less reads
- and see if PFBS has less reads than others leading to unclear results in DESeq2

"Bowtie 2 / HiSAT2
Results from both Bowtie 2 and HISAT2, tools for aligning reads against a reference genome.http://bowtie-bio.sourceforge.net/bowtie2; https://ccb.jhu.edu/software/hisat2DOI: 10.1038/nmeth.1923; 10.1038/nmeth.3317; 10.1038/s41587-019-0201-4
Single-end alignments
This plot shows the number of reads aligning to the reference in different ways."


import sequence mapped from multiqc (pfas manifest v1.2 - end2end)
```{r}
reads_distr <- read.table("~/Documents/School/thesis/PFAS_project_preprocessing_pipeline/Results_from_pipeline/bowtie/pfas_manifest_v1.2/end2end/pfas_v1.2_bowtie2_se_plot.tsv", header=TRUE, sep = "\t")
```

```{r}
reads_distr
```
Remove _bowtie from the column sample
```{r}
reads_distr$Sample <- gsub("_bowtie","",reads_distr$Sample)
```

import the metadata_all
```{r}
# import the metadata file from analysis app
metadata_pfas <- read.csv("/home/lawrence/Documents/School/thesis/PFAS_project_R-analysis/results_from_analysis/data_input_deseq/metadata_all.csv")  %>% select(X,SRR,chemical,duration,dose) %>% filter(chemical %in% c("DMSO_pfas","PFBS","PFOS","PFDS","PFOA")) %>% rename("Sample" = "SRR")
metadata_pfas
unique(metadata_pfas$chemical)
```
Merge the reads_distr with the metadata_pfas
```{r}
merged_df <- full_join(metadata_pfas, reads_distr, by = "Sample")
merged_df
```
Now group by chemical, duration, and dose
```{r}
merged_df_arranged <- merged_df %>% arrange(chemical,duration,dose)
merged_df_arranged
```
Take the mean of mapped.uniquely of the replicates for each sample group (duration and dose)
```{r}
chemical_summary <- merged_df %>% group_by(chemical,duration,dose) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_unique_mapped = mean(SE.mapped.uniquely, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_samples = n()
  ) %>%
  arrange(chemical,duration,dose,mean_unique_mapped)

chemical_summary
```
How about grouping just by chemical and duration, including dose would be too much
```{r}
chemical_summary <- merged_df %>% group_by(chemical,duration) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_unique_mapped = mean(SE.mapped.uniquely, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_samples = n()
  ) %>%
  arrange(chemical,duration,mean_unique_mapped)

chemical_summary
```



Create a bar graph comparing them all
```{r}
ggplot(chemical_summary, aes(x = chemical, y = mean_unique_mapped, fill = chemical)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") + #stack is the other option
  facet_wrap(~ duration, scales = "free_y",
             labeller = labeller(duration = function(x) paste("Day", x))) + 
              # apply function to facet variable to add "day"
  labs(
    title = "Mean of Uniquely Mapped Reads by Chemical Treatment",
    subtitle = "Comparing read depths across different durations (days)",
    x = "Chemical",
    y = "Mean of Uniquely Mapped Reads",
    fill = "Chemical"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set1") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = label_comma()) +     # 1,500,000
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1), # Rotates chemical names so they don't overlap
    legend.position = "none" # Hide legend since X-axis labels already show the chemicals
  )
```

```{r}
chemical_summary_simple <- merged_df %>% group_by(chemical) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_unique_mapped = mean(SE.mapped.uniquely, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_samples = n()
  )

chemical_summary_simple

ggplot(chemical_summary_simple, aes(x = reorder(chemical, mean_unique_mapped), y = mean_unique_mapped, fill = chemical)) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip() + # Horizontal bars are easier to read
  labs(
    title = "Overall Mean Uniquely Mapped Reads per Chemical",
    x = "Chemical",
    y = "Mean Uniquely Mapped Reads"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set1") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = label_comma()) +     # 1,500,000
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```
```{r}
ggplot(merged_df, aes(x = chemical, y = SE.mapped.uniquely, fill = chemical)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.5, outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.2, alpha = 0.9) + # Shows individual samples as dots
  labs(
    title = "Read Count Distribution Across PFAS Chemicals",
    x = "Chemical",
    y = "Uniquely Mapped Reads"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = label_comma()) +     # 1,500,000
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set1") +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```
